title: Open lattice faces are disjoint, and their union is flat near each of its points
statement: Assume (FG), the exact frozen Lean type of Submission.cmcdtfr_face_geometry. Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let S be a finite set of pairs p = (ι, b) (ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing, b ∈ ℤ^P). Write Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} (y ∈ ℝ^k), Q₁ := (0,1)^k, F̆_p := Φ_p(Q₁), C := ⋃_{q∈S} F̆_q and V_p := span{e_{ι(j)}}. Then (a) F̆_p ∩ F̆_q = ∅ for distinct p, q ∈ S; and (b) for every p ∈ S and t ∈ Q₁ there is δ > 0 such that, for all z ∈ ℝ^P with |z − Φ_p(t)| < δ, z ∈ C ⟺ z − Φ_p(t) ∈ V_p.
